metadata.title: Agentic Web Standards: the open standards for AI agents, in plain words
metadata.description: An open, plain-language field guide to the standards that let AI agents find, use, sign in to, shop on and pay websites. What each one does, who is behind it, and how real it is today.

image.alt: Agentic Web Standards: twelve standards, five jobs, grouped by what each does for an AI agent
image.heading: The agentic web, standard by standard
image.line: What each one does, who is behind it, and how real it is today.

footer.about: An open, community-edited guide. Every page is a file in a public repository, so anyone can fix a sentence or add a standard with a pull request.
